provenance: Fresh full-book narrative and exact-source-selection comparison after explicit-frame/eager-GC backport and Functions soundness proofs. Rechecked the prior unit-specific reasoning against current raw units, selected declarations/tests, dependencies and review policy; corrected obsolete pre-exit/completion descriptions. No independent reviewer or subagent was used.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.syntax.heap.validation against rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:parse, rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:edge_target, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::bad_facts_fail_instead_of_silently_changing_the_graph, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::arrays_materialize_uninitialized_slots_and_validate_indices, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:lease_tests::leases_join_edges_and_shleases_target_objects, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:cycle_tests::cycles_self_loops_and_disconnected_cycles_render_deterministically, test:mdbook-dada/tests/renderer_contracts.rs:diagram_array_size_boundary_preserves_all_slots. parse rejects duplicate nodes/slots, absent targets, invalid projections and arrays above 64; edge_target requires leases to name an initialized owned or leased edge. Tests cover the 0/64/65 boundary, invalid targets and supports, variable-store restrictions and deterministic cyclic examples. Ownership cycles are intentionally accepted rather than presented as valid language states. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.syntax.heap.nodes.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review.

Implementation/test inspection is correspondence evidence; actual command results are recorded separately. Tests do not prove universal behavior, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution.
